# StackPick

> Independent, practical software guides for freelancers and small businesses. We focus on fit, workflow, limitations and trade-offs rather than feature counts alone. Vendor links currently go directly to the vendors; StackPick does not currently earn affiliate commissions from those links. Google Analytics is configured. Display ads are not currently served.

## Start here
- [StackPick homepage](/): overview of the publication and its approach.
- [All software guides](/best): searchable, category-filtered directory of software comparisons and practical guides.
- [About StackPick](/about): editorial approach and scope.
- [Affiliate Disclosure](/affiliate-disclosure): current commercial-link status and future disclosure policy.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): analytics and current advertising status.
- [Contact](/contact): corrections and enquiries.
